sources.name: zatca_implementation_resolution
sources.note: Rebuilt: recovered Arabic text for 9 operative sections + annexes from the official ZATCA Implementation Resolution PDF (previously 141/144 English chunks had no Arabic counterpart at all — a pure article-count check had masked this). Fixed the lam-alef position-swap bug (لا/ال transposition, confirmed unidirectional). 10 ar_ entries total (ar_1-ar_9 + ar_annexes), 144 en_ entries unchanged. 154/154.

sources.name: zatca_guidelines
sources.note: Reconstructed 7 corrupted glossary definitions (ar_2.3, ar_2.9-2.13, ar_2.18) using parallel English entries as reference; trimmed TOC-noise from ar_7.1. Known remaining gaps: TOC-bleed in ar_5.1/ar_7.5/ar_4.2, ar_6.1's flattened requirements table — not yet addressed.

sources.name: zatca_vat_agreement
sources.note: Full rebuild via OCR: the source PDF's embedded font has a kashida/tatweel-to-letter mapping bug causing severe text stretching (confirmed present across independent extraction tools and multiple PDF sources — not an extraction-tool artifact). OCR bypasses the broken font mapping entirely. 71/71 articles recovered from an official ZATCA-hosted copy, verified zero residual stretching.

sources.name: labor
sources.note: 248/248 articles (238 substantive + 10 explicitly repealed placeholders, plus a few 'مكرر' bis additions — replaces the previous under-extraction of 188/245). Re-extracted with pdftotext. Fixed: ligature-order bugs (لأ/لإ/لآ systematically reversed to أل/إل/آل; scrambled word-final '-لاً' endings, e.g. تشغيلاً/مقبولاً), and chapter/part heading text bleeding into the tail of the preceding article. Known remaining noise: one isolated stray-diacritic artifact (cosmetic only).

sources.name: misa
sources.note: 16/16 articles, re-extracted with pdftotext + line-level AR/EN classification (fixes a token-level bug in the previous pdf-parse version where English words with trailing punctuation, e.g. 'Law,'/'Article:', leaked into text_ar in all 16 articles). Tatweel stripped; a few isolated dropped-letter spots fixed (e.g. التعريفات, الوزارة). Known remaining noise: minor letter-spacing within words from the source PDF's justified-text rendering (cosmetic, does not affect meaning or searchability materially).
